readerCopy.body: A little more freedom can make an option that once looked awkward or impractical suddenly workable. When Lilith sextiles the North Node, autonomy and forward movement cooperate through a changed rule, different term, added privacy, or refusal of an expectation that never fit. The difference does not have to become a rebellion. One condition can change enough to reveal a path that approval had been quietly keeping off the table.
